instructions: PrintCraft edits PDFs. Open a file with doc_open to get a document id, then inspect (doc_info, text_extract, text_find, page_render) or edit it (page_*, doc_set_info). Edits are undoable (edit_undo) and stay in memory until doc_save. Page numbers are 1-based. Open documents are also resources: printcraft://doc/{doc}/info, /text, /page/{page}/text and /page/{page}/image.
